writeup: Woot has the Fluval PF2 Programmable Fish Feeder (model 10786, 85 ml drum) new for $24.99. Retail Market charges $109.49 for the same feeder, and Bay Bridge Aquarium lists it at $69.99 but is out of stock. It runs on AA batteries and handles up to two automatic feedings a day, and Woot shows only one left.
